text_block_list.text:
One day, when I stopped by the cafeteria, 
I heard a mysterious incantation being 
chanted...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: U... Unya, ubya, nuna, myumya!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Sooo close! But you're looking really 
good~!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Mnh, wuna, wubya...? *yaaaawn*, I can't do 
this~ My tongue's completely twisted~

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer... Actually, we have a singing 
test in class soon, and—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
There's a tongue-twister-like part in the 
assigned song... and it's super 
difficult...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
And that is why I, Matikanefukukitaru, am 
accompanying her in training!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Doto-san, here we go, okay~? 
"Uma-uma-umya-unya, 3, 2, 1," go!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: "Una! Nuna! Ubyaa, funyaa~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
It's no use after all~~! I'm so sorry, 
even troubling you, Fukukitaru-san~~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
No, no, not at all! Today's fortune said 
that helping others brings super mega good 
luck!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, aren't we always partners in 
searching for lucky items together~?"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, thank you so much... Still, at this 
rate, I feel like no matter how much I 
try, it's just no use...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
What should I do to become a better 
singer, I wonder~?
choice_data_list:
If we're gonna practice, we might as well 
make it fun.

Maybe we should look for a fundamental 
solution...?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Um, h-having fun, how do I do that...?

Thinking it would be best since they were 
going to practice anyway, I brought the 
two of them along to a karaoke parlor.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh, that's great, it really gets the 
hype going! Let's have all the fun we... I 
mean, let's practice hard today!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... B-But holding a microphone might 
just make me even more nervous...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Come, now. If you're nervous about singing 
alone, let's do a duet! Let's see, where's 
the remote, the remote—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Aha, I totally tripped over my words too~! 
This song really is tricky, isn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Well, as long as it sounds fun, a little 
bit should be fine! The important thing is 
smiling—good fortune comes to those who 
smile!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I-I'm sorry. Fukukitaru-san looked 
like she was having so much fun that I, I 
got caught up in it...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
No, no~, nice and relaxed! Maybe it'll 
work right now? Ready, and... heave-ho!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh? Uuuuuuum, well—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Uma-uma-umya-unya, 3, 2, 1, hyai!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh~! That's your best one yet! You did 
it, Doto-san!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
*Yaaawn*, thank you so much~! It's all 
thanks to you, Fukukitaru-san~!

Meisho Doto smiled with relief. She seems 
to have built a wonderful relationship 
with the easygoing Matikanefukukitaru.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: A fundamental solution, you say...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I see, understood! Times like this 
call for divine intervention! Let's go, 
Doto~!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh? Whaaaat? P-Please wait up~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Doto-san! Let's get to praying! 
Pour your heart out with all you've got! 
Don't hold back!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Pour it all out, with a bang!? U-Um, yes, 
but... I'm so nervous, I wonder if I can 
say it properly—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um, excuse me! No, I mean, O Great 
Kami-sama! Hauwawa... M-My... My t-tail is 
gonna get... eek!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-It's no good~~! When I get nervous, I 
can't say my prayers properly at all~~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Now, now, calm down and take a deep 
breath first. God is forgiving, so take 
your time, it's alright!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Y-You're right... *inhale*... 
*exhale*...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um, D-Dear God... I want to be able to 
sing the assigned song without stumbling 
over my words, pleaseee.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: —I was able to say it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Magnificent, Doto-san! Maybe you could 
sing if it's at a slower pace?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Let's give it a shot right away! It'll be 
fi~ne, even the gods are cheering us on 
right now!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Uma... uma... unya... unya. Uma, uma, 
unya, umya?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Nyohoo~! Just a little bit more!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Uma-uma, umya-unya—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I-I managed to say it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It's perfect! You did it, Doto-san! All 
you have to do now is pick up the pace 
little by little!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hawaaaaa, thank you so much, God and 
Fukukitaru-san~~!

Matikanefukukitaru stayed by her side to 
practice until the very end. It seems 
Meisho Doto has truly found a wonderful 
friend.
